title: SentinelCI RootCauseGroup v1
description: Advisory output of the correlator (task A7, SPEC section 8): the findings of one run that share a root cause, and the one fix for them. Never read by the release gate: the verdict never depends on it. A run's groups travel in a correlation document (correlation.v1.json), which ties them to the findings they were computed from.

group_id.description: sha256 hex of the sorted finding ids joined by '|': the same members always give the same id, and one more member gives another. So it is stable within a run, not across runs: scope URLs by run, and follow a group's history through `key` and its members.

finding_ids.description: Finding v1 ids (fingerprints), sorted, at least one. A finding is in exactly one group of a run.

stage.description: The correlation stage that formed the group (SPEC section 8): dedup (one fingerprint), structural (a shared fix key such as a package), embedding (similar text). Who wrote the labels is `labelled_by`.

labelled_by.description: Who wrote title, root_cause and single_fix: the correlator's templates, or a model (stage 3, which labels groups and never forms them).

similarity.description: For an embedding group: the average-linkage cosine similarity of its last merge (a confidence for the dashboard). Only for stage embedding.

key.description: The structural key the members share (for example package:pkg:npm/lodash, or rule:<id>@<path>, whose path may hold spaces), when there is one.

root_cause.description: One paragraph, no line break (a model's text is joined into one by the producer).

single_fix.description: The one change that resolves every member, or null when there is none.

model.description: For labelled_by llm: what produced the labels (SPEC section 8: model, prompt and input hashes are logged).
